# Recorded IBKR volatility data

The unchanged `H_AAPL.csv`, `H_SPX.csv` and `report_mdt3_live.json` were copied
from `tmp/ibkr_iv_spike_out/`. They were captured on 2026-11-06 using a paper
Gateway and delayed market data (type 3). Both history files retain their
full two-year depth. IV values are upstream decimal fractions.
